title: Dan Recht - Startup Lessons Learned From Roguelikes
speaker: Dan Recht
description:
Dan Recht talks about how roguelikes taught him how to lead a startup.
This video is from the 2017 Roguelike Celebration: https://roguelike.club/event2017.html
